Backend Failure
      What it means
      User Response
      System Action
      Queue Failure
      The email couldn't be added to the outbound email queue.
      "We're having trouble sending your verification email right now. Please try again in a few moments." Show Retry and Contact Support if repeated.
      Retry queue automatically → Log error → Alert if persistent.
      Mail Provider Failure
      The email provider (e.g., SendGrid, Resend, AWS SES) is unavailable or returned an error.
      "Our email service is temporarily unavailable. Please try sending the verification email again shortly."
      Retry automatically, then allow manual resend.
      Timeout
      The request to the email service took too long and no confirmation was received.
      "Sending your verification email is taking longer than expected. Please wait a moment or try again."
      Continue processing in the background if possible; otherwise retry.
      SMTP Failure
      The mail server rejected or couldn't process the email.
      "We couldn't send your verification email at the moment. Please try again."
      Retry with backoff; log the failure.
      Hard Bounce
      The email address is permanently undeliverable (e.g., invalid or nonexistent).
      "We couldn't deliver the verification email to this address. Please check that it's correct or use a different email address." Offer Edit Email and Resend.
      Mark address as undeliverable and stop automatic retries.
      Soft Bounce
      Delivery failed temporarily (e.g., recipient mailbox full or temporary server issue).
      "Your verification email couldn't be delivered right now. We'll try again automatically, or you can resend it."
      Retry automatically with exponential backoff.
